summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. priced $877,000 of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon (With Memory) Barrier Notes due October 11, 2028, issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program via a Rule 424(b)(5) pricing supplement. The notes are senior unsecured obligations linked to the worst-performing of Autodesk, Cooper Companies, Gen Digital, and Qualcomm common stocks, with quarterly contingent coupons of $50.00 per $1,000 note, quarterly autocall observations beginning April 2027, and a stated principal of $1,000. This is a routine structured-note shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch credit spread and correlation risk.
